meta.title: QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection: refused for a user without the Quality Inspector role
gaps: Select or verify the Enterprise tenant because no tenant identifier is provided and no plan-tier step exists.
Sign in as a user without the Quality Inspector role.
Locate and attempt QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection and observe whether Procol refuses or omits it.
Repeat the action as a Quality Inspector and compare availability with the non-Quality-Inspector user.

args.need: sign in as a user without the Quality Inspector role on the Enterprise tenant, test QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection, then repeat as a Quality Inspector and compare whether the action is refused or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot access GRN workflows or switch between users and roles, so the tester must perform the role-based comparison.
Checks that the resulting screen has no crash, server error, undefined values, or raw identifiers, but does not assert the QC Hold behavior.
